name: Detroit Edible | 200mg Barracuda Cup | Goodnight Milk Chocolate Peanut Butter (4:1 THC:CBN)
description:
New CBN infused Barracuda Cups! - Peanut Butter Rest 

Michigan's #1 chocolate edible just went bite sized. These delicious Belgian chocolate bite-sized cups are filled with savory peanut butter. Infused with a potent 200mg THC per pack, these mini treats have some bite! Each cup (8 per pack) contains 25mg THC and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
